BBSC keeps co-op sessions going through deaths, lamps, and boss fights, but it relies on detailed knowledge of the game’s code that this project doesn’t include. Bells, summons, messages, and bloodstains work without it. Everyone in a BBSC session must have it installed, so you can’t join those sessions without it. Support may come later, depending on further development and discussions with BBSC’s developer.

recomp.title: Recompiled code
recomp.subtitle: Compile the game's code for this device once, instead of translating it while you play.
recomp.what1: Bloodborne was written for the PS4's processor. Normally its code is translated into this device's instructions while you play. Recompiling does that once, ahead of time: the launcher compiles the game's code from your own copy into a library the game then uses.
recomp.what2: With it, the game uses less processor time (about 14% less in our tests), so the device has more to spare and runs cooler. The frame rate stays about the same, because the graphics set the pace.
recomp.what3: The compiled code still behaves like the PS4's processor, so this isn't a native version of the game. It's built from your copy and stays on this device.
recomp.translatedHint: The default. Works with every copy of the game, with nothing to build.
recomp.recompiledHint: Uses the library built below. If it doesn't match your game, the game's code is translated instead, and the log says why.
recomp.modeNeedsLibrary: Build the library below to choose Recompiled.
recomp.buildHint: Building downloads a 70 MB compiler, takes about 14 minutes on a fast device (longer with fewer cores), and needs about 3 GB of free space while it runs. Afterwards the library takes about 330 MB and the compiler is deleted. You can keep using the launcher, but playing while it builds will be slow.
recomp.staleGame: Built from another copy of the game. Build it again to use it.
recomp.staleRecompiler: Built by an earlier version of the recompiler. Build it again to use it.
recomp.cancelled: Cancelled. Building again continues where it stopped.
recomp.unavailable: This version of the app doesn't include the recompiler.
recomp.needsGame: Select your game folder on Home first.
